description:
Comparis helps you find suitable apartments and houses in Switzerland.

By connecting Comparis with ChatGPT, you’ll get access to one of the largest selection of property listings across Switzerland. Get all the key information about a property at a glance, including photos, property descriptions,  all combined with ChatGPT’s conversational capabilities.

Try asking by voice or text, things like:
- Show me a 4-room apartment with a balcony and a kitchen isle in Zurich for under CHF 4,000 per month 
- Find me a modern house to buy in Basel with white bathrooms
- Are there any apartments with a lake view and parking space in Lausanne?

You can refine your search at any time by telling ChatGPT more about your preferences and requirements. Try it now and connect Comparis with ChatGPT.

defaultPrompt: Find a bright Zurich rental with a kitchen island and outdoor space
Find a house to buy in the canton of Basel for two adults and three children.
